g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: PCM5122 - left woofer, right tweeter, register controlled

g.desc: Title: PCM5122 - left woofer, right tweeter, register controlled

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: MODE1=0, MODE2=1; ADR2=ADR1=0 -> I2C 0x4C (7 bit). SCK grounded.

g.desc: MODE1=0, MODE2=1; ADR2=ADR1=0 -> I2C 0x4C (7 bit). SCK grounded.

g.text: BCK -> PLL reference; use 64fs BCK and I2S 32-bit slots. Enable normal clock-error handling.

g.desc: BCK -> PLL reference; use 64fs BCK and I2S 32-bit slots. Enable normal clock-error handling.

g.text: P0 R13 SRCREF=BCK (0x10). P0 R61/R62 = channel digital volume; ramp together for master volume.

g.desc: P0 R13 SRCREF=BCK (0x10). P0 R61/R62 = channel digital volume; ramp together for master volume.

g.text: OUTL -> woofer (TPA right bridge); OUTR -> tweeter (TPA left bridge).

g.desc: OUTL -> woofer (TPA right bridge); OUTR -> tweeter (TPA left bridge).

g.text: R2/R3 + C16/C19 retain 470R/2n7 C0G output filtering; amp input pads limit full-scale level.

g.desc: R2/R3 + C16/C19 retain 470R/2n7 C0G output filtering; amp input pads limit full-scale level.

g.text: XSMT pulled low by R32 until GPIO18 releases mute. Keep volume muted throughout setup.

g.desc: XSMT pulled low by R32 until GPIO18 releases mute. Keep volume muted throughout setup.

g.text: VCOM grounded in default VREF mode. LDOO decoupled; unused GPIO3-6 are no-connects.

g.desc: VCOM grounded in default VREF mode. LDOO decoupled; unused GPIO3-6 are no-connects.

g.text: Clock loss automatically powers down DAC/line drivers. Valid but incorrect DSP data still needs limiting.

g.desc: Clock loss automatically powers down DAC/line drivers. Valid but incorrect DSP data still needs limiting.

g.text: All grounds share GND; route analogue return to source, away from amplifier switching currents.

g.desc: All grounds share GND; route analogue return to source, away from amplifier switching currents.
